```{r}

dir <- "~/Desktop/PhD/NMC/results"

#read interaction file
interaction_tumor_to <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "Tumor_cells_interaction_to.csv"))

interaction_tumor_from <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "Tumor_cells_interaction_from.csv"))

interaction_MDSCs_from <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "MDSCs_interaction_from.csv"))

interaction_t_to <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "CD8+_T_cells_interaction_to.csv"))

interaction_t_from <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "CD8+_T_cells_interaction_from.csv"))
#read infiltration

median_infiltration_cozi <- infiltration_cozi %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise("median_infiltration" = mean(infiltration, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(median_infiltration))

infiltration_me <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "NMC_infiltration_percentage.csv"))

median_infiltration_me <- infiltration_me %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise("median_infiltration" = mean(percentage, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(median_infiltration))

survival <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "NMC_survival_time.csv")) %>%
  #group into less than 7, 7-14, and 14+
  mutate(survival_group = case_when(
    survival_time_months < 7 ~ "< 7 months",
    survival_time_months >= 7 & survival_time_months < 14 ~ "7-14 months",
    TRUE ~ "14+ months"
  )) %>%
  arrange(patient_exp)

tumor_area <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "tumor_area.csv")) %>%
  mutate("tumor_area" = log10(tumor_area))
```

Infiltration

```{r}
#Extract the patient numbers between the two underscores from infiltration_me_mat$patient_ID

infiltration_me <- infiltration_me %>%
  mutate(patient_nb = str_extract(patient_exp, "(?<=_)[^_]+(?=_)")) %>%
  #make column numeric
  mutate(patient_nb = as.numeric(patient_nb))

infiltration_me_mat <- infiltration_me %>%
  select(!c(total_cells, infiltration, X)) %>%
  arrange(patient_nb, factor(cell_type, levels = median_infiltration_me$cell_type)) %>%
  select(!patient_nb) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "patient_exp", values_from = "percentage") %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "cell_type") %>%
  as.matrix()



main_col_fun = colorRamp2(
  c(0.25, 0.5, 1), 
  c("#0055FF", "#f7f7f7", "#FF0000FF")
)


row_ha = rowAnnotation(
  "median_infiltration" = median_infiltration_me$median_infiltration,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  annotation_name_rot = 45,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

#Let's save the heatmap as svg

svglite::svglite(filename = "~/Desktop/heatmap_output_infiltration.svg", width = 12, height = 8)


ht = Heatmap(infiltration_me_mat,
        name = "Infiltration",
        col = main_col_fun,
        column_names_rot = 45,
        right_annotation = row_ha,
        row_split = cells_split,
        border = TRUE,
        heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Infiltration"),
        cluster_rows  = FALSE,
        cluster_columns = FALSE,
        column_title = "Samples",
        row_title = "Cell Types",
        row_names_side = "left",
        column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
        column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
        row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
)

draw(ht)

dev.off()
```

```{r}

interaction_tumor_to <- interaction_tumor_to %>%
  mutate(patient_nb = str_extract(patient_exp, "(?<=_)[^_]+(?=_)")) %>%
  #make column numeric
  mutate(patient_nb = as.numeric(patient_nb)) %>%
  #Remove -Tumor_cells from cell_pair column 
  mutate(cell_type = gsub("-Tumor_cells", "", cell_pair))

cell_types <- c(
  "MDSCs", "M2_macrophages", "M1_macrophages", "M1_M2_macrophages",
  "DCs", "Granulocytes", "B_cells", "CD8+_T_cells", "Treg_T_cells",
  "Mast_cells", "NK_cells", "CD4+_T_cells", "Plasma_cells"
)

cell_types_order <- paste0(cell_types, "-Tumor_cells") 

interaction_tumor_to_mat <- interaction_tumor_to %>%
  arrange(patient_nb) %>%
  select(!cell_type) %>%
  select(!patient_nb) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "patient_exp", values_from = "zscore") %>%
  arrange(factor(cell_pair, levels = cell_types_order)) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "cell_pair") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  scale()
```

```{r}
# Step 1: Get median zscore per cell_pair to order
cell_pair_order <- interaction_cor %>%
  group_by(cell_pair) %>%
  summarise(median_z = median(zscore, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(median_z)) %>%
  pull(cell_pair)

# Step 2: Reorder factor levels
interaction_cor <- interaction_cor %>%
  mutate(cell_pair = factor(cell_pair, levels = cell_pair_order)) 

my_comparisons <- combn(unique(interaction_cor_subset$cell_pair), 2, simplify = FALSE)


# Step 3: Plot
a = ggplot(interaction_cor, aes(x = cell_pair, y = zscore, fill = cell_pair)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5,) +
  labs(
    title = "Immune cells interaction with Tumor_cells",
    x = "Cell Pair",
    y = "Interaction Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", label = "p.format", comparisons = my_comparisons) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  #hide legend
  theme(legend.position = "none")

#Let's save the ggplot

ggsave(
  filename = paste0("~/Desktop/interaction_plot_", choice, ".svg"),
  plot = a,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300,
)
```

```{r}
#Let's see if MDSCs interaction is correlated negatively with CD8+_T_cells

interaction_cor = interaction_tumor_to %>%
  group_by(patient_exp) %>%
  mutate("zscore" = scale(zscore)) %>%
  #make interactions na 0
  ungroup() %>%
  #fill NA with 0
  #filter(cell_type %in% c("MDSCs", "CD8+_T_cells", "M2_macrophages")) %>%
  select(!cell_type)

#pivot the data wider for it first
interaction_cor_wide <- interaction_cor %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "cell_pair", values_from = "zscore")

#let's do a ggplot as boxplot to compare
ggplot(interaction_cor, aes(x = cell_pair, y = zscore, fill = cell_pair)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter() + 
  labs(title = "MDSCs interaction with Tumor cells vs CD8+ T cells interaction with Tumor cells",
       x = "Cell Type",
       y = "Interaction Score") +
  theme_minimal() +
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", label = "p.format", label.y = 2.5)

c = ggplot(interaction_cor_wide, aes(x = `CD8+_T_cells-Tumor_cells`
, y = `MDSCs-Tumor_cells`)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Correlation between MDSCs and CD8+ T cells interactions to Tumor Cells",
       x = "MDSCs Interaction",
       y = "CD8+ T cells Interaction") +
  theme_minimal() +
  stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.x = 0.5, label.y = 2)

#save c
ggsave(
  filename = paste0("~/Desktop/correlation_plot", choice, ".svg"),
  plot = c,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300,
)
```

```{r}
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
   stat_compare_means()
```

```{r}

interaction_t_to_survival <- interaction_t_to %>%
  group_by(patient_exp) %>%
  mutate("zscore" = scale(zscore)) %>%
  ungroup()

sd = sd(interaction_t_to_survival$zscore, na.rm = TRUE)
mean = mean(interaction_t_to_survival$zscore, na.rm = TRUE)

interaction_t_to_survival$patient_exp <- gsub("_[^_]+$", "", interaction_t_to_survival$patient_exp)

interaction_t_to_survival <- interaction_t_to_survival %>%
  filter(cell_type %in% c("MDSCs")) %>%
  select(!cell_type) %>%
  group_by(patient_exp) %>%
  summarise("zscore" = mean(zscore, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(zscore_group = case_when(zscore > mean + sd ~ "High MDSCs-CD8+_T_cells interaction", 
                                  zscore < mean + sd ~ "Low MDSCs-CD8+_T_cells interaction",
                                  is.na(zscore) ~ "Low MDSCs-CD8+_T_cells interaction"))

  
survival_copy <- survival
survival_copy$patient_exp <- gsub("_[^_]+$", "", survival_copy$patient_exp) 
survival_copy <- survival_copy %>%
  filter(!duplicated(patient_exp))

interaction_t_to_survival <- interaction_t_to_survival %>%
  left_join(survival_copy, by = "patient_exp") %>%
  select(patient_exp, zscore_group, survival_time_months)

#Make survival plots
interaction_t_to_survival$zscore_group <- factor(interaction_t_to_survival$zscore_group)
# Add status = 1 for "event occurred" (adjust if you have true censoring info)
interaction_t_to_survival$status <- 1



#remove patient 1
#interaction_tumor_to_survival <- interaction_tumor_to_survival %>%
 # filter(patient_exp != "NMC_1")
# Create survival object
surv_obj <- Surv(time = interaction_t_to_survival$survival_time_months, event = interaction_t_to_survival$status)

# Fit survival curve
fit <- survfit(surv_obj ~ zscore_group, data = interaction_t_to_survival)

# Plot
ggsurvplot(
  fit,
  data = interaction_t_to_survival,
  pval = TRUE,                 # shows p-value from log-rank test
  pval.coord = c(10, 0.95),
  risk.table = FALSE,          # shows number at risk
  conf.int = FALSE,            # show confidence interval
  palette = c("#E7B800", "#2E9FDF"), # color customization
  title = "Survival by MDSCs-CD8+_T_cells Interaction Group",
  xlab = "Time (months)",
  ylab = "Survival Probability",
  legend.labs = c("High MDSCs interaction", "Low MDSCs Interaction")
)



```
